At Digital Hub, we are committed to delivering exceptional results and exceeding expectations in every project we take. With passion for excellence and a dedication to staying ahead of industry trends, we are your trusted partner for all your digital needs.

Our expertise in Data Science, AI Transformation, Outsourcing, Software Development, and consultations ensures impactful, sustainable results. fields.heading: Four stages. No surprises.
fields.lead: Every engagement follows the same structured delivery model. You know what’s happening at every stage.

steps.title: Discover & Define
steps.text: We map your current processes, identify the pain points, and define the outcome we’re building toward. No assumptions. We sit with your teams until we understand what done looks like.

image.alt: Discovery and requirements workshop with stakeholders

steps.title: Architect & Design
steps.text: We design the solution architecture, data model, and user experience before writing a line of code. You see and approve how the system works before it’s built. Changes here are free.

steps.title: Build & Integrate
steps.text: We develop in iterative sprints with regular demos. Every two weeks you see working software, not status reports. Integration with existing systems happens in parallel — not as an afterthought.

steps.title: Deploy, Support & Improve
steps.text: We manage production deployment, run UAT with your team, and stay on after go-live. Performance is monitored. Bugs are fixed. Enhancements planned against a shared roadmap.

case-studies.title: 3+ years powering Egypt’s national planning systems

fields.summary: Full development of Egyptian planning systems for the Ministry of Planning & Economic Development — data warehouse, cybersecurity, advanced dashboards, and platform support.

image.alt: Government planning and national data systems

fields.heading: Modernizing national planning on legacy foundations

blocks.text: The Ministry needed a single, authoritative view of economic and development planning data across departments — while meeting strict cybersecurity requirements and keeping mission-critical systems available around the clock. Fragmented sources, manual reporting cycles, and aging infrastructure made it difficult for leadership to act on timely, trusted intelligence.

Digital Hub was engaged to design and deliver the full stack: enterprise data warehouse, hardened security posture, executive dashboards, and sustained platform operations aligned with public-sector governance.

fields.heading: End-to-end platform ownership from warehouse to operations

blocks.text: Our team led the development of Egyptian planning systems end to end — consolidating disparate feeds into a governed data warehouse, implementing cybersecurity controls and monitoring, and building advanced dashboards tailored to ministry leadership and technical teams.

items: Enterprise data warehouse architecture with ETL pipelines and data quality rules
Cybersecurity hardening, access control, and operational security practices
Executive and operational dashboards for planning, monitoring, and reporting
Dedicated platform support — incident response, releases, and capacity planning

blocks.text: Engagement models combined on-site delivery with offshore engineering capacity, giving the Ministry predictable velocity without sacrificing accountability to national stakeholders.

fields.heading: Trusted planning intelligence at national scale

blocks.text: After three years of partnership, the Ministry operates on a unified data foundation that supports strategic planning cycles, cross-agency coordination, and evidence-based policy decisions. Leadership dashboards replaced weeks of manual consolidation with near-real-time visibility into key indicators.

Security and support SLAs keep critical systems resilient — enabling the organization to focus on economic development outcomes rather than infrastructure firefighting. The engagement remains active, with Digital Hub continuing to evolve the platform as planning priorities shift.

case-studies.title: End-to-end data center transformation for Central Bank of Egypt

fields.summary: Infrastructure and digital transformation consulting for the Credit Guarantee Corporation — establishing a complete data center and enterprise information infrastructure.

fields.heading: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"paragraph","content":[{"type":"text","text":"End-to-end data center transformation for "},{"type":"text","text":"Central Bank of Egypt","marks":[{"type":"italic"}]}]}]}

image.alt: Banking data center and enterprise infrastructure

fields.heading: Standing up regulated infrastructure from the ground up

blocks.text: Credit Guarantee Corporation required a complete data center and enterprise information infrastructure to support its role within Egypt’s banking ecosystem — with expectations set by Central Bank of Egypt oversight. Legacy facilities and ad-hoc systems could not meet availability, security, or audit requirements for financial-sector operations.

The organization needed a trusted partner to translate regulatory and business requirements into a deployable architecture — spanning physical infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, backup, and operational runbooks.

fields.heading: Infrastructure and transformation consulting, delivered end to end

blocks.text: Digital Hub provided infrastructure and digital transformation consulting — leading discovery, design, procurement support, implementation oversight, and handover for a full data center build-out and supporting enterprise information systems.

items: Data center facility planning — power, cooling, rack layout, and physical security
Network, compute, and storage architecture with redundancy and DR alignment
Enterprise information infrastructure — directory services, monitoring, backup, and operations tooling
Migration planning and cutover support for critical workloads

blocks.text: Our consultants worked alongside internal IT and vendor teams to ensure every layer — from raised floor to application connectivity — met CBE-aligned governance and operational readiness criteria.

The Credit Guarantee Corporation now operates on a purpose-built data center platform designed for resilience, auditability, and growth. Teams gained standardized environments, documented procedures, and visibility into capacity and health — reducing reliance on fragmented, high-risk legacy setups.

The transformation established a foundation for future digital initiatives — core systems integration, analytics, and partner connectivity — without revisiting fundamental infrastructure decisions. Digital Hub’s engagement model combined strategic advisory with hands-on delivery accountability expected in regulated banking contexts.

case-studies.title: 500+ endpoints under real-time Nexthink DEX monitoring

fields.summary: Deployed Nexthink DEX across a major bank’s full IT environment — giving the IT team live visibility into endpoint health and employee experience at scale.

image.alt: Digital employee experience monitoring across bank endpoints

fields.heading: Blind spots across a distributed banking workforce

blocks.text: A leading Egyptian bank operated hundreds of endpoints across branches, headquarters, and remote roles — yet IT lacked unified visibility into device health, application performance, and the digital experience employees actually encountered day to day. Reactive support tickets and siloed monitoring tools made it difficult to prioritize fixes or prove service quality to business stakeholders.

Leadership wanted a single platform to understand endpoint friction before it became outages — aligned with modern Digital Employee Experience (DEX) practices and Nexthink’s industry-leading observability model.

As a Nexthink Authorized Reseller, Digital Hub designed and executed a full-environment rollout of Nexthink DEX — from architecture and agent deployment through dashboard configuration, integrations, and IT operations enablement.

items: Discovery and scoping across branches, HQ, and hybrid work patterns
Phased agent rollout to 500+ endpoints with minimal business disruption
DEX scorecards, alerts, and executive views tailored to banking IT workflows
Knowledge transfer so internal teams can run, tune, and expand the platform

blocks.text: Deployment aligned with the bank’s security and change-management processes — ensuring DEX telemetry complemented existing SIEM and service desk operations rather than replacing them.

fields.heading: Proactive IT with measurable employee experience

blocks.text: IT teams now operate with live visibility into endpoint health and employee experience at scale — shifting from ticket-driven firefighting to data-informed remediation. Recurring friction points surfaced through DEX analytics, enabling targeted fixes that improved satisfaction and reduced mean time to resolution.

The bank established a sustainable DEX practice supported by Digital Hub’s Nexthink expertise — with room to expand monitoring, automate remediation playbooks, and tie experience metrics to broader service management goals across the organization.
